Game Overview

In Rootbeer Floater, the core idea is straightforward: dive into the bubbly madness of Rootbeer Floater, where you become T Awesomesauce, defending your perfect rootbeer recipe. Evade relentless obstacles seeking a taste, while collecting power barrels to unleash powerful attacks. With swift moves and strategic barrel grabbing, navigate an increasingly challenging adventure packed with sippable thrills!
